title: Bessent Warns All Iranian Airlines Will Be 'Shut Down' Worldwide Starting Sept 23
detail: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that on September 23 'all the Iranian airlines will be shut down around the world' under sweeping new secondary sanctions, part of Day 206 economic pressure. The Treasury order bars foreign airports, fuel suppliers and ticketing agents from servicing Iranian carriers — chiefly Mahan Air, which Washington accuses of ferrying IRGC personnel and weapons — or risk exclusion from the US dollar financial system. Named targets included Malaysia-based iCargo, Kazakhstan-based Tour Invest, and Turkish firms MES Cargo and S Sistem Logistics, all accused of providing logistics or ticketing support to sanctioned carriers.

title: Unknown Projectile Strikes Tanker Entering Strait of Hormuz; UK Agrees to Refuel Saudi Jets Against Houthis
detail: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported an 'unknown projectile' struck a tanker as it sailed into the Strait of Hormuz, lightly injuring two crew members; the vessel continued under its own power and no group claimed responsibility. Separately, Britain agreed to provide the Royal Air Force for limited air-to-air refueling of Saudi Arabian jets flying defensive missions against intensifying Houthi attacks, with officials saying the arrangement would begin within weeks. IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi warned that 'the war is not over' and threatened to 'change the geography of the war' with new weapons and tactics if the US escalates further.
